say:1:1820520001:0.text: Did you see Thane's face, Estrilda? I haven't laughed that hard in ages!
say:1:1820520001:0.source_cn: 爱丝你看见了吗？瑟恩刚才的表情太好玩了！哈哈哈！

say:2:1820520002:0.text: I did! He looked just as silly as he used to!

say:4:1820520004:1.text: You guys are tempting fate by fooling around! Don't you realize the Bantus soldiers could show up any second?
say:4:1820520004:1.source_cn: 现在情况危急，你们竟然还有闲心恶作剧？班题斯士兵随时可...

say:5:1820520005:0.text: Calm down, Thane. I was just trying to lighten the mood. I just don't want to see Estrilda and <style="stress"><player_name></style> moping around all day like you.
say:5:1820520005:0.source_cn: 别这样，瑟恩，我只是想活跃一下气氛。总不能让爱丝和<s...
say:5:1820520005:0.male: Calm down, Thane. I was just trying to lighten the mood. I just don't want to see Estrilda and <style="stress"><player_name></style> moping around all day like you.
say:5:1820520005:0.female: Calm down, Thane. I was just trying to lighten the mood. I just don't want to see Estrilda and <style="stress"><player_name></style> moping around all day like you.

say:6:1820520006:0.text: You haven't changed at all... Why?!
say:6:1820520006:0.source_cn: 你还是和以前一样……为什么你还是这样？！

say:7:1820520007:0.text: I don't know how you do it, but you can still crack jokes even when everything's falling apart...
say:7:1820520007:0.source_cn: 无论身处何种险境，你总有闲心开玩笑……你……

say:8:1820520008:0.text: You're talking about Baden, not me. Or... at least not who I am now.
say:8:1820520008:0.source_cn: 但那是你认识的巴登做的事，不是我。呃，至少不是现在的我。

say:10:1820520010:0.text: Thane stops himself just as the words reach his lips.
say:10:1820520010:0.source_cn: 瑟恩似乎还想说些什么，但话至嘴边，又被他硬生生咽了回去。

say:14:1820520011:0.text: Then, he turns away from everyone, his heaving chest betraying his struggle to keep his anger in check.
say:14:1820520011:0.source_cn: 他转过身去，不再看向你们，激烈起伏的胸膛暴露了他的情绪...
say:14:1820520011:0.male: Then, he turns away from everyone, his heaving chest betraying his struggle to keep his anger in check.
say:14:1820520011:0.female: Then, he turns away from everyone, his heaving chest betraying his struggle to keep his anger in check.

say:16:1820520013:0.text: Y-You're not seriously mad, are you? Come on...
say:16:1820520013:0.source_cn: 你……你真的生气了？不要这样吧……

say:17:1820520014:1.text: Rain approaches Thane from behind, careful not to rile him up again.
say:17:1820520014:1.source_cn: 里纳一边说着，一边小心翼翼地靠近瑟恩，生怕再次点燃他的怒火。

say:23:1820520015:1.text: Without warning, Thane spins and strikes at Rain. Though caught off guard, Rain's body reacts before his mind does, blocking the attack.
say:23:1820520015:1.source_cn: 此时瑟恩却忽然转身，迅速抽剑攻向了毫无防备的里纳——然...

say:24:1820520016:1.text: While everyone else remains stunned, Thane calmly sheathes his sword.
say:24:1820520016:1.source_cn: 然后……里纳愣住了，你和爱丝特瑞达也愣住了。只有瑟恩，...
say:24:1820520016:1.male: While everyone else remains stunned, Thane calmly sheathes his sword.
say:24:1820520016:1.female: While everyone else remains stunned, Thane calmly sheathes his sword.

say:25:1820520017:0.text: You blocked that move the first time we dueled, and you just did it again.
say:25:1820520017:0.source_cn: 我们第一次对决，你就防住了这招。此刻亦是。

say:26:1820520018:0.text: If that isn't proof you're Baden, I don't know what is.
say:26:1820520018:0.source_cn: 所以，别再说你不是巴登这种话。

say:27:1820520019:0.text: That's... just a coincidence. Anyone would've reacted the same way if a sword came swinging at them.
say:27:1820520019:0.source_cn: 这……这只是巧合。有人朝自己挥剑，无论是谁都会下意识想...

say:28:1820520020:0.text: ... If you still don't believe me, fight me.

say:30:1820520022:0.text: Ugh, what's gotten into him... Rain, catch this!
say:30:1820520022:0.source_cn: 真讨厌……里纳，接住这把剑！
